PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
Planning Commission: Mario Maciel, Jr., David L. Muse, Gilbert Padilla, Joanna Valenzuela, and Ken Woods.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
Three (3) minute speaking time limit
Tres (3) minutos es el tiempo límite para hablar
THIS IS THE TIME SET ASIDE TO ADDRESS THE PLANNING COMMISSION
PLEASE NOTIFY THE PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY IF YOU REQUIRE THE SERVICES OF AN INTERPRETER
No action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The legislative body or its staff may: 1) Briefly respond to statements made or questions asked by persons; or 2) Direct staff to investigate and/or schedule matters for consideration at a future meeting. [Government Code §54954.2]
ESTE ES EL PERIODO DESIGNADO PARA DIRIGIRSE A LA COMISION DE PLANIFICACION URBANA
FAVOR DE NOTIFICAR A LA SECRETARIA SI REQUIERE LOS SERVICIOS DE UN INTÉRPRETE
No se podra tomar acción en algún asunto a menos que sea incluido en la agenda, o a menos que exista algúna emergencia o circunstancia especial. El cuerpo legislativo y su personal podran: 1) Responder brevemente a declaraciónes o preguntas hechas por personas; o 2) Dirigir personal a investigar y/o fijar asuntos para tomar en consideración en juntas proximas. [Código de Gobierno §54954.2]

2)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT MODIFICATION TO ALLOW AN UPGRADE FROM THE OFF-SITE SALES OF BEER AND WINE (TYPE 20) TO THE OFF-SITE SALES OF DISTILLED SPIRITS (TYPE 21) AND TO MODIFY STORE HOURS OF OPERATION PURSUANT TO SECTIONS 153.120.050.A.2 AND 153.210.130.B.4 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 3100 BALDWIN PARK BOULEVARD; APPLICANT: TARGET CORPORATION; CASE NUMBER: CP-816.) Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 14-14 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE OFF-SITE SALE OF DISTILLED SPIRITS (TYPE 20 LICENSE) IN CONJUNCTION WITH A DEPARTMENT STORE AND MODIFICATION TO HOURS OF OPERATION PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.070.020 AND 153.210.130.B.4 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 3100 BALDWIN PARK BLVD.; APPLICANT: TARGET CORPORATION; CASE NO.: CP-816)."
Staff Report
3)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION TO MODIFY AN EXISTING EXHIBIT "A", REDUCING THE FLOOR AREA OF A PROPOSED WAREHOUSE BUILDING BY APPROXIMATELY 2,235 S.F., ADDING ELEVEN (11) NEW PARKING SPACES ALONG THE WEST SIDE OF THE BUILDING, THE ELIMINATION OF ONE (1) GRADE LEVEL LOADING ZONE, AND ADDITIONAL LANDSCAPING/PLANTING AREA AT THE SOUTHWEST CORNER OF THE BUILDING BY THE PRIMARY ENTRANCE TO THE BUILDING, WITHIN THE (I), INDUSTRIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210.130.B.2 AND 4 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 4730 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: HOLLADY CONSTRUCTION, INC., LLC; CASE NO.: CP-810MOD). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 14-17 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING THE MODIFICATION OF AN EXISTING EXHIBIT "A", REDUCING THE FLOOR AREA OF A PROPOSED WAREHOUSE BUILDING BY APPROXIMATELY 2,235 S.F., ADDING ELEVEN (11) NEW PARKING SPACES ALONG THE WEST SIDE OF THE BUILDING, THE ELIMINATION OF ONE (1) GRADE LEVEL LOADING SPACE, AND ADDITIONAL LANDSCAPING/PLANTING AREA AT THE SOUTHWEST CORNER OF THE BUILDING , WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL (I) ZONE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210.130.B.2 AND 4 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 4730 LITTLEJOHN STREET; APPLICANT: HOLLADY CONSTRUCTION, INC. CASE NO.: CP-810MOD).
Staff Report
4)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) LOT INTO TWO (2) LOTS WITHIN THE C-2, GENERAL COMMERCIAL ZONE (LOCATION: 1516 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: GREG SCHLARBAUM; CASE NUMBER: PM-1424). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 14-16 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT APPROVING A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP, SUBDIVIDING ONE LOT INTO TWO LOTS LOCATED IN THE C-2, GENERAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 1516 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: GREG SCHLARBAUM; CASE NUMBER: PM-1424)"
Staff Report

Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 14-15 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT APPROVING A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP, APPROVING THE VACATION/RELOCATION OF AN EXISTING PUBLIC ALLEYWAY FOR INDUSTRIAL PURPOSES, AND THE CONSOLIDATION OF TWO (2) LOTS INTO ONE (1) LOT WITHIN THE I-C, INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 13127 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: YAN WANG; CASE NUMBER: PM-1419)"
Staff Report
